backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, CarMeet, Comment, DirectMessage, Notification, BuildStage, etc.) and including storage/authorization mixins for the RevReel platform backend.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping the landing page hero car image replacement feature to its affected file (LandingPage.tsx) and associated components/test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose, key hooks, styling approach, and notable implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the RevReel Vite/React app, mounting the React root and loading the main TSX entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with all app routes; the landing page renders without a layout shell while all other pages are nested under a shared Layout wrapper.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that shows a loading spinner during initialization, a neon-styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or renders children when the user has an active Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component displaying a car meet's title, category, location, date, and attendee count, with attend/leave toggle buttons for authenticated users and a past-event badge.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: A modal dialog that lets the authenticated user select one of their own videos to challenge another user's video, then submits the challenge via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: A full-screen overlay panel that displays sorted comments for a video, supports @mention autocomplete, and allows authenticated users to post new comments.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the current user's profile, including username, bio, and avatar upload, which submits changes via the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: A button component that toggles following/unfollowing a user, showing appropriate icons and loading state, with toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app shell providing a fixed header with logo/auth controls, a navigation bar with badge counts for notifications and messages, and conditionally renders a ProfileSetupModal for new users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: A dialog form for posting a car mechanics issue with title, category, and description fields, submitting to the community via the createMechanicsPost mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog component for creating a new parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, datetime, category, and description, then submitting via the useCreateCarMeet mutation with the date converted to nanoseconds.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A non-dismissible modal for first-time profile setup that collects a username, bio, and optional avatar image, then calls useCreateUser to persist the profile.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for starting a new car build log, collecting title, make, model, year, and description, then submitting via the useCreateBuildLog mutation.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A full-featured video/photo card component that handles playback, muting, likes, emoji reactions, save/unsave, delete, view count incrementing, comments panel, and challenge modal for a single feed item.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor instance changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, wrapping DFINITY's AuthClient to expose login, logout, and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend canister, covering user profiles, videos, comments, build logs, car meets, messaging, and more, along with their associated TypeScript types.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, defines CSS custom properties for a dark-themed design system with neon accents, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glass-card styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that allows authenticated admin users to view their principal ID and delete users by ID, with access-denied states for non-admins and unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single build log that displays car build information and stages, and allows the owner to add new stages or delete the entire build log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Displays a list of user build logs as cards with car details, stages count, and creation date. Includes an authenticated 'New Build' button that opens a modal to start a new build log.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single car meet including date, location, attendees, and category. Allows authenticated users to join or leave the meet with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Lists all car meets with category and date filters, showing each meet's location, date, and attendee count. Authenticated users can attend or leave meets and post new ones via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Displays active classified listings with category filtering, showing image, price, condition, and description for each item. Authenticated users can post new listings via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation between the current user and another user, with send, delete, and mark-as-read functionality. Messages auto-scroll to the bottom and support Enter-to-send.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Provides a search and discovery page for videos, users, and hashtags with debounced input. Also displays browsable category tiles and trending hashtags derived from all videos.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main video feed page with 'For You' and 'Following' tabs, vertical snap-scroll through videos, mute state persisted in sessionStorage, and skeleton/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered video feed page that displays videos by category or hashtag based on URL params, with a back-navigation header and the same snap-scroll layout as Feed.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Messaging inbox page that lists conversation summaries with unread counts, timestamps, and avatar lookups, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and Internet Identity login; redirects authenticated users to the feed automatically.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Leaderboard page showing top trending videos by likes and top uploaders ranked by total likes, computed from all videos data.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Detail view for a single classifieds listing, showing image, price, condition, seller info, and a remove button visible only to the listing's seller.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Displays a paginated, filterable list of mechanics help posts with category tabs and a modal to create new posts. Authenticated users can post new issues; all users can browse posts sorted by recency.
Shows the full detail view of a single mechanics help post including its comments, and allows authenticated users to add comments or delete the post if they are the author.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Renders a list of user notifications with type-specific icons and timestamps, supporting mark-as-read for individual or all notifications and navigating to the sender's profile on click.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays a user's profile page including avatar, badges, stats, uploaded videos, and saved videos, with support for editing profile details and avatar upload for the authenticated owner.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Provides a form for authenticated users to upload a video or photo with title, description, category, hashtags, and optional thumbnail, tracking upload progress and navigating to the feed on success.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts (Barlow/Barlow Condensed), an oklch-based color palette with neon accents, custom shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes using typography, container-queries, and tailwindcss-animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the RevReel project, recording existing features, a pending action request to replace the landing page hero car image with a tuner-style generated asset, and metadata like schema version and clarification settings.
